en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a seaside promenade with stone pavement along a harbor. Men in early 20th‑century clothing walk beside the water, small sailboats are moored along the quay, and multi‑story European-style buildings and a tram line run along the cobbled street. The caption area at the bottom contains Greek and French text identifying the scene as the quays of Salonique (Thessaloniki).
